title: Say Maanos a Kamarerwa
intro: Diad saray salaysay na inkapropeta, walay sakey a kamarerwa ya say anos to et akaukit ed mismon inkatoo ra. Diad panamegley na lua tan panaon, sikaray nansiansia ed ilalo, a nagmaliw iran ag-onsaew ya ehemplo na panagmatalek ed madibinon kakabatan. Sarag mon naukbar so misteryo na sayan ag-onkupas a pigura?
clues: Nianak ak ed pamilya na saray propeta, balet say sankabalgan ya subok ed siak et diad samay ugaw ya inad-arok.
Akaawat ak na pasakbay na imon manlapud sakey a kugip ya inabang na anak ko, tan natatakot ak ed kaligenan to.
Nanputi iray matak lapud ermen, balet agkon balot naandi so pananisiak ed panangasi nen Allah.
Say angob na abalang ya anak ko et akasabi ed siak manlapud arawi, tan amtak ed saman ya asingger lay pankakasakey lamet.
Inmabeba so pamilyak bilang pisasalamat nen asumpal so pasingawey nensaman, tan pinmawil so pakanengneng ko.
Siak so inikdan na kamiseta ya amagaan na dala, balet diad saginonor et akaawat ak na kamiseta ya amaabig ed pakanengneng ko.

trial.label: Say Importante a Bista
options: Say inkasian ed inad-aro ya anak tan pakaandi na pakanengneng
Say pangibantak ed mandarlang ya apoy
Say inakmon na baleg a sira
Say pansungdo ed pakaandi na kayamanan, ananak, tan bunigas
Sikatoy intraidor na saray agagi to tan imbantak ed bobon
trial.answer: Say inkasian ed inad-aro ya anak tan pakaandi na pakanengneng

location.label: Say Simbolikon Bengatla
options: Sakey a kamiseta ya inmunan angiyamot na katuaan insan to imparungtal
Sakey a baston a nagmaliw ya uleg
Sakey a balyena ya angakmon ed sakey a propeta
Sakey ya apoy ya nagmaliw ya ambetel
Sakey a paris na sandalyas ed mandarlang a kakiewan
location.answer: Sakey a kamiseta ya inmunan angiyamot na katuaan insan to imparungtal

outcome.label: Say Madibinon Resolusyon
options: Say pakapinengnengan lamet ed sakey ya inatey ya inad-aro tan say pakanengneng lamet
Iliktar manlapud sakey a bansan napapairap
Say pangiliktar ed eges na sira
Kilalaban manlapud mandarlang ya apoy
Insegep ed baleg a trono
outcome.answer: Say pakapinengnengan lamet ed sakey ya inatey ya inad-aro tan say pakanengneng lamet

arabic: قَالَ إِنَّمَآ أَشْكُوا۟ بَثِّى وَحُزْنِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: He said, "I only complain of my suffering and my grief to Allāh, and I know from Allāh that which you do not know. (12:86)
